mapper.select: SELECT ld.ts_code AS ts_code, ld.stock_name AS stock_name, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Int32)) AS board_pos, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(String)) AS limit_style, ld.pct_chg AS pct_chg, ld.amount AS amount, ld.turnover_rate AS turnover_rate, COALESCE(ld.board_code, '') AS board_name FROM limit_down_pool AS ld FINAL WHERE ld.trade_date = #{tradeDate} ORDER BY ld.pct_chg ASC
